text: This track features an incredibly angry and aggressive rock sound, utilizing a 4/4 time signature at a fast tempo of 160 BPM. Driven by distorted power chords and relentless double-bass drumming, it spans 32 bars of high-intensity energy.
An angry rock composition in a minor key that emphasizes heavy syncopation. The music lasts for 45 seconds and features a wide pitch range of 4 octaves, creating a volatile and explosive atmosphere.

The music presents an angry rock aesthetic with a slow, sludge-like tempo of 70 BPM. Spanning 16 bars, the deep, resonant bass notes and crashing cymbals provide a sense of overwhelming weight and fury.

This short 20-second snippet of angry rock music is characterized by a rapid-fire 12/8 time signature. The melody is dissonant and sharp, played across a 3-octave range to evoke a feeling of chaotic frustration.
Featuring a dense polyphonic texture, this angry rock track runs for 60 seconds. It utilizes frequent staccato notes and a highly irregular rhythmic pattern to mirror a sense of unpredictable rage.
An intense angry rock performance spanning 24 bars. The piece is dominated by a mid-range pitch focus and a constant crescendo, leading to a powerful and sonically abrasive climax.

This track is a fast-paced angry rock anthem in a Phrygian mode, adding a dark, menacing quality to the sound. It maintains a consistent 4/4 meter over 40 bars with a very high velocity for all MIDI notes.
A gritty and angry rock piece that focuses on a low-register riff. The music has a runtime of 35 seconds and uses a 3/4 time signature to create a jarring, waltz-from-hell rhythmic feel.

This song features an angry rock vibe with sharp, biting articulation and a syncopated rhythm. Spanning 20 bars, the composition uses a wide dynamic range to transition from simmering tension to explosive outbursts.
A 50-second angry rock track with a complex arrangement of 16th-note patterns. The harmonic language is filled with tritones and chromaticism, emphasizing a raw and unyielding musical character.
